div.head: Geþyncðo 8
div.ab: 7 gif hit gewurde þæt man gehadedum oððe ælþeodigum ahwar gederode wordes oððe weorces, þonne gebyrede cinge 7 bisceope, þæt hig þæt betan, swa hig raþost mihton.
Et si eueniret, ut ordinatus uel alienigena distraheretur alicubi uerbis uel operibus, tunc pertinebat regi et episcopo hoc emendare, quam citius possent.
And gif man gehádedum oððe ælþeodigum ahwar gederede wórdes oððe weorces, þonne gebyrede biscpe 7 cynge, þæt hi þæt betan, swa hi raðost mihton.
And gif hit gewurde þæt man gehadedum oððe ælþeodigum ahwar gederode wordes oððe weorces, þonne gebyrede cinge and bisceope þæt hig þæt bettan swa hig raþost mihton.

Und wenn es geschah, dass jemand einem Geweihten oder Fremden irgendwo in Wort oder That Schaden zufügte, dann gebührte dem König und Bischof, dass sie so schnell sie konnten [den Thäter] dies büssen liessen.

And if it happened that someone did harm to an ordained man or a stranger anywhere in word or deed, then it was for the king and the bishop to make [the offender] atone for it as quickly as they could.
And if anyone, anywhere, injured an ecclesiastic or a stranger by word or deed, then it was the concern of the bishop and the king, that they should atone for it as quickly as they could.
And if it so happened anywhere that someone injured one in orders or a stranger by word or deed, then it was the responsibility of the king and the bishop to remedy it as swiftly as they could.
div.note: D has ‘bishop and king’ in that order. In H, Norðleod follows. Liebermann compares II Cn 40.
